# Lucide source assets

These 25 SVG icons are copied without geometry changes from the official Lucide repository.

- Project: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide
- Source files: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/main/icons
- License source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/blob/main/LICENSE

The full upstream LICENSE is included. The project anatomy page may inline the SVG markup; keep its license notice and this directory with the deliverable.
